title: Anthropocentric bias in language model evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Theoretical analysis and taxonomy creation, reviewing existing behavioral and mechanistic interpretability studies (e.g., syntactic competence, analogical reasoning) to identify how applying human-centric standards leads to flawed evaluations. The paper introduces frameworks for mitigating 'auxiliary oversight' and 'mechanistic chauvinism' by supplementing behavioral experiments with test-time compute interventions and mechanistic analyses.
